stories.title: Canada loses 4,700 jobs in October, unemployment rises to 6.7%
stories.summary: Statistics Canada reported a loss of 4,700 jobs in October 2026, pushing the national unemployment rate up to 6.7% from 6.5% in September. The decline follows larger back‑to‑back job losses in August and September that together eliminated more than 100,000 positions. Economists had previously forecast a gain of 13,600 jobs for October.
stories.why: The rise in unemployment signals a weakening labour market, which can affect consumer spending and policy decisions.

stories.title: India's October consumer inflation likely nears top of RBI target on food costs
stories.summary: A Reuters poll reported by the Economic Times projects that October consumer price inflation will be close to the upper end of the Reserve Bank of India's 2‑6% target range, with food price increases identified as the main driver. The forecast puts inflation near the 6% ceiling.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
stories.summary: OpenAI has reportedly raised $11 billion so far in a new funding round that values the AI lab at $1.25 trillion. Bloomberg writes that some potential buyers believe Anthropic’s valuation could be as low as $1.1 trillion, compared with the $2 trillion that investors were said to be expecting roughly a month ago.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.

stories.title: 13 Indian IPOs double issue price between Oct 2025‑Nov 2026
stories.summary: An Economic Times slideshow lists 13 companies that listed from October 2025 to November 2026 and posted returns above 100% on their IPO issue prices, with gains ranging from about 156% to 193%. Omnitech Engineering recorded the highest gain at 192.62% (issue price Rs 227 to Rs 664.25), while ESDS Software Solution, KSH International and INDO‑MIM each delivered returns above 150%. The piece includes each firm’s issue price, listing‑day price and amount raised.
stories.why: Demonstrates that recent Indian IPOs have produced substantial short‑term price appreciation, a factor investors may consider when evaluating new listings.

stories.title: Micron stock tanks 17% as AI chip selloff deepens: What's next?
stories.summary: Micron Technology shares witnessed a massive selloff on November 5, plunging 17.46% to close at $656.39, their lowest level in nearly six months. The stock also touched an intraday low of $650 as investors dumped semiconductor and AI-related stocks amid growing concerns over the outlook for the AI trade.
stories.why: This can affect market expectations, company valuations, sector sentiment or capital flows.

stories.title: Alek Minassian, convicted in deadly 2018 Toronto van attack, drops appeal
stories.summary: Ontario’s top court says Alek Minassian has abandoned the appeal of his convictions on 10 counts of first-degree murder and 16 of attempted murder. Eight women and two men died on April 23, 2018, when Minassian — enraged that women wouldn’t sleep with him and radicalized online — deliberately drove a rented van down a crowded sidewalk in his quest for infamy.
